--frame after a headless run on the Stall wrote a valid PNG, IHDR 800 x 480; same for ~45 other frames.
Fresh title texts [Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up -> 0, 8x down -> 4; down x4 then enter at tick 4 with --ticks 20 printed tick 4, screen title.
Settings texts [Settings, Language: English, Difficulty: Normal, Season: 7 days, Back]; L,R,R,R -> es; diff L x3 easy, R x3 hard; season R,R -> 3, R,L,L -> 7; Escape and Enter on Back -> title.
Run 1 set es/hard/3; run 2 on same store started es/hard/3; fresh store en/normal/7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

Same 23 flows in en and es covering all 12 screens: same number of texts each, no es string equal to its en one apart from Day Market and clock strings; settings texts turn Spanish on the same word (Idioma: Español...). Key label 'Enter' kept in 'Enter: abrir'/'Enter: título'.
data/strings.json holds an en table and an es table, code reads them via tr(); README 'Languages' says add a top-level key copying every en key.
Fresh: enter -> texts [New season, Slot 1: Empty, Slot 2: Empty, Slot 3: Empty]; escape -> title.
enter,enter -> morning day 1 slot 1 coins 50 rep 50, all stock [], prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning, Day 1 of 7, Coins: 50; slot 3 start gives slot 3.
Easy start coins 60, Hard 40; 3-day season 'Day 1 of 3', forecast length 3; after changing settings to easy/7 and Continue, season_difficulty hard, season_length 3.
Seeds 1-6: 7 entries each from sun/cloud/rain/heat, weather == forecast[0], text 'Weather: Cloud' etc; seed 3 run twice gives the same forecast.
24 seeds: wholesale seen apples 1-4, bread 2-5, cheese 5-8, fish 6-9, flowers 2-5, honey 4-7, never outside; rows like 'Apples: 4 a unit, stock 0' match price and stock.
Apples at 1: one lot coins 44, stock [{6,5}]; second lot [{12,5}], coins 38, row 'Apples: 1 a unit, stock 12'; honey lot days_left null.
Fish at 9 with 50 coins: Enter leaves coins 50, stock [], adds 'Not enough coins'; next word ('none') removes it. Kept place with 96 apples and 500 coins: Enter on apples changes neither.
Day 1 order null; day 2 over 8 seeds units in 4/6/8, pay = units*ref*3//2, e.g. 'Order: 6 Bread for 54'; accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 4 Apples for 24'; second accept identical state.
After New season, later run: title [Day Market, New season, Continue, Records, ...]; Continue screen 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'.

Unbroken run at day-2 Morning vs later run with --seed 99 doing Continue: day, coins, reputation, stock, stall, prices, upgrades, forecast, wholesale, order, texts all equal; Enter on empty slot 2 stays on slots.

Escape on Morning -> texts [Paused, Resume, Title]; Resume and Escape return identical state; Title -> title, Continue shows coins 50, no apples. Day paused 200 ticks clock stays 0; resumed run matches unpaused (clock 10).
Stall texts [Stall, Day 1 of 7, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 6, Crates: 0 of 8, Enter: open], cursor (0,0), selected apples.
8 cursor sequences (up raises y, up up -> y1, down stops 0, left stops 0, 7x right -> 5) all as expected.
next_good x0..6: apples, bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples with Good/Price/Stock texts following; prev_good -> honey, twice -> flowers.
put -> stall [{0,0,apples}], 'Crates: 1 of 8'; put on occupied cell unchanged; take -> [] 'Crates: 0 of 8'; take on empty no change; 12 puts -> 8 crates, 'Crates: 8 of 8'.
apples price_up x10 -> 12 'Price: 12'; price_down x6 -> 1; fish price_up x30 -> 42.
Stall of 4 crates and prices apples 5, bread 5 set on day 1 are the same at day-2 Morning and after Continue in a later run (seed 99).
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts include 08:00, Speed: Slow, taken/served/walked_out/passed 0, visitors 76 entries.
Seeds 1,2,3: ids 1..n, minutes strictly increasing in 0-479, wants distinct with counts 2/1/2/3 by type, all four types seen; same seed same list, seed 2 different.
100 ticks after opening: slow clock 5 (08:05), fast 20, rush 100 (09:40), hold 0 with tick 131 and screen day; 10 slow ticks then fast 3 ticks -> clock 1 (progress kept).
finish given at tick 32 with --ticks 32: screen evening, clock 480; taken 101 served 12 passed 64, coins, sales, rep equal to the rush-to-end run.
Same day at slow (9600 ticks), fast, rush, and mixed fast/hold/rush/slow + pause + finish: identical coins 87, taken 101, served 12, walked 0, passed 64, sales, stock.
Driving the game's own Game class minute by minute over 27 days (1642 visitors): every visitor on aisle at x = clock-m for m..m+5 and off from m+6; 0 violations.

Same 27 days: no good outside wants or repeated; no back-row take with an empty basket except right after a front-row take in the same look (164 cases, reading 'then the back if its basket holds something'), and with Sign; 0 violations.
Apples 4 at column 2: cook #6 arriving 51 has [] at clock 52 and [{apples,2,4}] budget_left 32 at clock 53. Full days: at price 5 no cook took apples (7 wanted), tourists took at 6, none at 7.
Every minute of 27 days: budget_left = budget - basket total and >= 0, each take within percent and budget, units held in aisle+queue+tills never above stock (incl. scarce-stock days); 0 violations.
Every visitor leaving at m+6: empty -> not queued and passed +1 (389 total), with goods -> end of queue with joined m+6 or at a till (1245); 0 violations.

1218 sales checked: end minute = start+2+goods, ends shown in tills, paid = total less tenth for bargain, coins/taken/served/reputation deltas match, stock leaves lowest days_left batch first; 0 violations.
No minute with a free till and a non-empty queue; tills ending at m refilled at m; a sole visitor leaving the aisle to an empty queue with a free till is at the till that minute; 0 violations.
No queued wait ever >= patience; 21 walkouts each with walked_out +1 and reputation -2 (clamped), held-units invariant shows goods free again; 0 violations.
At 480 screen evening; served+walked_out+passed+left-at-close equals visitor count and walked_out/passed unchanged by closing, in all 27 days.
With second_till (kept place): tills has 2 entries, both busy at the same minute 429 times, till 2 never filling before till 1.
With sign: 410 back-row takes by visitors with an empty basket; without sign none (beyond the same-look case).
Day-2 order 4 apples/24 taken with 5 in stock: evening coins 200+24-20=204, 1 left, 'Order delivered: 24'; with none: rep 45, 'Order failed'; not taken: coins 180, rep 50, no order line.
Bread bought day 1 gone at evening 1 ('Bread: sold 0, spoiled 6, left 0', spoiled 6); fish days_left 1 then spoiled evening 2; honey 6 units days_left null both evenings.
Seed 3 day 3 heat: apples 5 -> 3 and cheese 2 -> spoiled without Cool box; with it apples 4, cheese 1.
3 crates, no sales: Easy 'Rent: 21', Normal 'Rent: 26', Hard 'Rent: 36', coins down by the same.
Evening texts [Evening, Day 1 of 7, Taken: 101, Served: 12, Walked out: 0, Passed: 64, six good lines matching sales and stock, Rent: 28, Coins: 87, Reputation: 62, Tomorrow: Sun, stamps].
Enter on Evening -> [Upgrades, Coins: 87, Next day, Second till: 80, Cool box: 40, Sign: 30, Extra crates: 50, Awning: 35]; Enter on Next day -> morning day 2.
Sign with 100: coins 70, upgrades [sign], 'Sign: owned'; again no change; Second till with 70: no change, 'Not enough coins'; Extra crates -> crate_limit 12, 'Crates: 0 of 12'.
Coins 5, Hard, 3 crates: evening coins -31 'Bankrupt', slots all null; Enter -> [Bankrupt, Score: 0, Days: 1, Best: 0, Enter: title]; records [{0,1,hard,bankrupt true}].
3-day season day 3, coins 100: evening 'Season over'; Enter -> [Season over, Score: 140, Days: 3, Best: 140, Enter: title]; slot emptied, later title has no Continue.

Fresh Records 'No records yet'; 7 seasons ended (scores 100,150E,120,150H,90,200,105) -> later run shows 200, 150 Easy, 150 Hard, 120, 105 (5 kept, ties earlier first); bankrupt shown 'Score 0, 3 days, Normal, bankrupt'.
Day 1 evening 'Stamp: First coin','Stamp: Sold out', stamps in order; day 2 with 8 served shows no stamp lines; later run Stamps screen 'First coin: yes', 'Sold out: yes', the rest ': no'.
8 crates -> full_stall, 7 -> not; day with sales -> first_coin, day with 0 served -> not; 3-day season ended on day 3 coins 80 -> whole_season.
Apples crate with 2 units sold out -> sold_out; crate with no stock -> not; a no-crate good emptied by the order -> not.
Day 2 played after Continue in a later run (seed 99) vs unbroken: visitors, sales, texts, coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, rep, stock, stamps identical.
Two copies of a kept place, seed 1, 500 ticks, same script: byte-identical output; fresh seeds 1 vs 2 differ in forecast, wholesale and visitors.
State unchanged (vs 'none') for Escape on Evening, Left/finish/rush/put on title, put/take/finish on Morning, accept/finish/rush on Stall, finish/rush on Evening/Upgrades/Paused, accept/put on Day.
data/game.json holds goods, visitor_types, hour_rates, weather, difficulty, upgrades, stamps; README 'Changing data' says how to change each.
Stall frame: 6x2 grid with back row on top, crates lettered and coloured per good (fish blue F, flowers pink F), white cursor at state's (2,1), Good/Price/Stock/Crates text.

Day frames: stall with crates, aisle visitors at state's cells coloured by type (cook white, bargain red, tourist green, regular purple), queue blocks, TILL 1/TILL 2 boxes with visitor, time, speed, coins, taken, served, reputation.

Title, slots, settings, morning, upgrades frames mark the chosen row with '>' and a bar; evening and season over show their texts. But Paused from the Stall (or Day) shows Paused/Resume/Title with no row marked, even with menu_index 1 (frame.py draws paused-over-stall without the menu marker).
README gives how to play (--play), the headless and frame commands (both ran with my own store and printed JSON / wrote 800x480 PNG), and the store files settings/slots/stamps/records.json.

defects: The state JSON is printed with ensure_ascii=False in the console's code page (cp1252 here), not UTF-8, so Spanish texts are not valid UTF-8 for a reader expecting it.
README says the default store is ./save, but the code defaults to a save folder beside daymarket.py (inside the game folder).
Paused over the Stall or Day: the frame does not mark Resume/Title as chosen.
Visitor labels in the day frame show only the last digit of the id (26 drawn as 6).
Spanish keeps the key name 'Enter' in 'Enter: abrir' and 'Enter: título'.
